action.action-desc: Ms. Van Duyne (for herself, Mr. Gill of Texas, Mr. Sessions, Mr. Self, Mr. Babin, and Mr. Fallon) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To increase penalties for certain violations of the H–1B nonimmigrant visa program, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the H–1B Visa Fraud Crackdown Act.

section.header: Increased penalties for serious H–1B violations
section.text: Section 212(n)(2)(C) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1182(n)(2)(C)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subclause (I), by striking $5,000 and inserting $100,000; and
in subclause (II), by striking at least 2 years and inserting at least 5 years; and
in subclause (I), by striking $35,000 and inserting $250,000; and
in subclause (II), by striking at least 3 years and inserting at least 10 years.

section.text: Section 274C(d)(3) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1324c(d)(3)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (A), by striking not less than $250 and not more than $2,000 and inserting not less than $1,000 and not more than $10,000; and
in subparagraph (B), by striking not less than $2,000 and not more than $5,000 and inserting not less than $20,000 and not more than $50,000.
